title: Q17
description:
“Ministering spirits sent forth to minister for those who will inherit salvation.”
Read: Psa 34:7, Psa 91:11–12, Heb 1:2
a) The Psalms show angels camping around and guarding those who fear Yahweh. What does that background bring forward about the role angels have, set against the Son's role as “heir of all things”?
b) Who inherits salvation, and how does that inheritance share in the Son's inheritance (1:2; Psa 2:8)?
